title: OmniChest
description: The first-ever inter-chest network search mod in Minecraft history
body:

---

## Features

### 🔍 Network-Wide Storage Search
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/ua-6xVrU6W0" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

![OmniChest-item-search-2](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dbec0055637a4b9893f49bf80660241fe3b3a22c.png)

![OmniChest-item-search-1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d8a59d3d64a795ccf65c1515f511dba103a2a414.png)
- Search for any item **across every chest you've ever opened** on the server.
- See exactly which chest, where, and how many — then OmniChest drops an in-world pin & beacon beam so you can spot it from a distance.
- Searches inside shulker boxes and ender chests (nested containers supported too)
- Creative-inventory-style category tabs and favorites (★)

---
### 🗂️ Category Sort
![OmniChest-main-menu](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ce52b52518be33955ccfeec95d1ef999fea46449.png)
- Automatically sorts a chest's contents into **meaningful categories** —
building, wood, ore, food, and more. Respects item tags and Creative-tab ordering,
and merges identical items into single stacks.


---
### 📥 Smart Deposit
- Deposits items from your inventory into a chest, **but only the types already stored
there**. Quickly offload your hotbar without messing up an organized chest.


---
### 📦 Compact
- Merge half-stacks of the same item into one with a single click — your inventory too,
if you want.


---
### 🔒 Slot Lock
![SlotLock](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e33e9e0838a4a782679d7a774d3a259d2b9dbbb3.png)
![SlotLock](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6e5d8cfbd8176a060439687cc602156988ff37d7.gif)
- Protect important items from sorting and deposits. Lock by **slot** or by **item**,
and optionally protect your hotbar, offhand, and armor slots by default.


---
### 📋 Chest Templates
![OmniChest-template](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1be5439fad9e8c2899667d8672f6721a42edface.png)
- Save a chest layout you like and reapply it to any other chest in one click.
Choose **Exact / Category / Hybrid** matching so material storages stay flexible.


---
### 🤖 Auto-Sort & Distribution
- Learns each chest's category from your deposit history, then **automatically routes
items to the right category storage**. Supports queued transfers to distant chests.

---

## Who it's for

- Players with sprawling storage bases that are impossible to keep tidy
- Anyone who loses track of where their items ended up
- Players who want a fast, vanilla-feeling organization mod

---

## Localization
![Languages](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/272d009df8e2b9a642b76af1a49d02e5cc640463.png)
Supports **27 languages + System Default**. You can even switch OmniChest's display
language **independently of Minecraft** (e.g. keep the game in English but read
OmniChest in your own language).

## Compatibility

- Dedicated render path to avoid conflicts with **Iris / Oculus** (shaders)
- Integrates with **REI / EMI / Inventory Profiles** and similar mods
- Built-in safety layers for resource packs and Unicode/CJK fonts

## Configuration

Every feature can be toggled and fine-tuned from **Mod Menu** (Cloth Config) —
which buttons to show, sorting speed, search radius, visual effects, and more.

---

## Requirements

| Item | Requirement |
|------|-------------|
| Minecraft | 1.21.11 |
| Mod Loader | Fabric |
| Required | Fabric API |
| Recommended | Mod Menu (for the settings screen) |
| Environment | **Client-side only** (no server install needed) |
